1	Yak-1/-9 or P-39 FIghter
2-3	IL-2 Sturmovik

rules.name: Cavalry Charge
rules.description: Once per game, a cavalry unit can make a special ‘Charge!’ move. This allows the unit to increase its speed to 12" for that turn, but once a cavalry unit has charged, it cannot charge again.
